articles.title: Mapping the 5.0-magnitude quake in China
articles.content: The 5.0-magnitude quake struck China’s southwestern Sichuan province on Aug 28. The US Geological Survey said the quake struck at a depth of 10.0km. Here’s where the quake struck and where the aftershocks with magnitudes above 2.5 were recorded.
